notes: This directory is the authoritative staged golden ISA definition for v0.57.
v0.57 is the sole active LinxISA profile and incorporates the complete established ISA contract.
v0.57 adds reviewed TMA Function 3..8 aliases, named PTO selectors, source-only B.IOT forms, and scalar CASB/CASH/CASW/CASD and DMA encodings.
The normalized PTO 0.57 inventory classifies all 111 workbook rows into 97 TEPL, 6 TMA, and 8 CUBE dispositions; named CUBE aliases retain the inherited generic BSTART.CUBE form.
B.IOD remains a reserved encoding. BSTART.PAR remains a retired spelling whose former bit pattern decodes only as BSTART.TEPL.
BSTART.TMA remains an encoding-family name, not a legal textual instruction.
